CBD Team Season Overview

Source: R/cbbd_teams.R
cbbd_teams_season_overview.Rd

Get a stored full-season overview of one team from the CollegeBasketballData API.

Usage

cbbd_teams_season_overview(team_id, season = most_recent_mbb_season())

Arguments

team_id

(integer required): CollegeBasketballData team id. See cbbd_teams() or cbbd_teams_directory() for valid values.

season

(integer required): Season, in 4-digit format ending-year (e.g. 2025 for the 2024-25 season). Defaults to most_recent_mbb_season().

Value

A named list of hoopR_data tibbles, one per section of the overview. team, record, ratings, efficiency and sources are one row each; shooting (one row per shot bucket), players (one row per player) and schedule (one row per game) are row tables. shooting also carries the attributes tracked_attempts (integer) and coverage, and players carries coverage: a list of state, reason, coveredGames and eligibleGames. A section upstream leaves empty comes back as a 0-column tibble. Types follow the values: a field upstream sends as null parses as logical NA, a whole-number value as integer, and a nullable object sent as null (e.g. the adjusted ratings) as one NA column in place of its fields.
